title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing's controls, credit billing and roadmap facts are supported by Microsoft documentation. The credit-allocation API is documented despite the automatic pre-check's warning. Minor corrections concern a missing checklist control row and a reference for the duplicate roadmap listing.

claims.claim: An agent node delegates one workflow step to an AI agent for reasoning.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes the environment credit allocation and tenant-draw rule.
claims.quote:
$apiBaseUrl = "https://api.powerplatform.com"
$apiVersion = "2024-10-01"
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" `
    -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody

claims.claim: MCSMessages is the entitlement ID for Copilot Credits in allocatedEntitlements[].entitlementId.

claims.quote:
enforcementRules = @(
                # Disable TenantPool so the environment is capped at its allocation.
                # Set enabled = $true to let the environment draw from tenant capacity.
                @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false }
